title: Maiyalis: Quest Board
description: Immersive notice boards for your world. Build as many boards as you have towns — a village noticeboard of hand-scrawled scraps, a guild wall of wanted posters, a municipal frame of official seals — pin parchment notices, wanted posters, rumours and jobs to them, and show one to the table for the players to browse. Each notice can link to a Journal entry or a quest from any other module. System-agnostic.
